about_short_description.short_description: Pantheon is a website operations platform that provides custom application services.

product.name: Pantheon WebOps Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for building, hosting, operating, and governing WordPress, Drupal, and Next.js websites across a web portfolio.

product.name: High-Performance Web Hosting
product.description: Managed cloud hosting for websites that require scalable infrastructure, performance optimization, security operations, and high availability.

product.name: WordPress Hosting
product.description: Managed hosting and operational services for WordPress websites, including deployment workflows, security, performance management, and scaling.

product.name: Drupal Hosting
product.description: Managed hosting for Drupal websites with cloud infrastructure, collaborative development environments, automated releases, security operations, and performance management.

product.name: Next.js Hosting
product.description: Managed cloud hosting for Next.js applications with native deployment, scaling, and operational support through Pantheon’s WebOps platform.

product.name: Website Portfolio Management
product.description: Centralized administration for managing multiple websites, users, environments, releases, and governance controls from one platform.
